trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[pf:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City), (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t) WHERE pf.tenure = 'latest' AND ((CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) <= 1989 AND p.college = 'University of Connecticut') OR (CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) >= 1 AND t.team_name <> 'Milwaukee Bucks')) RETURN c.city_name AS col1, p.draft_year AS col2, o.name AS col3, p.name AS col4, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team
